answer: Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. The design leans on cost-of-replication accounting, voided if the audit panel is not diverse, the cheapest attack must cost more than honest work. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short. Work waits on the tundra until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the zenith of the next round. What survives to the crystal is a record of labour, not a list of addresses.
